notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only evidence is one row on the Firetowers of Saskatchewan list (coordinates, with blank height, year, towermen and notes) and the Firelookout.ca entry (coordinates, Moose Range No. 486, and a note doubting the tower still stands). The two coordinate sets match. Two websearch.py queries and an AllTrails trail page (403) found nothing more. The story runs about 100 words, under the 120-word floor, because the record has no build, staffing or fate facts; the editor should decide whether to hold it. Brief status and kind were unknown and remain so. No agency is given because no source names one for this tower.
